title: tc-prompt-library
description: Saved prompt templates whose variables are filled in place.

templates.description: The saved templates, in list order – each with a title, an optional category and a body with {variables}

value.description: Id of the chosen template – unset or unknown shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

values.description: The variables typed so far, per template; a missing one shows its template default. Changed by the user unless a tc-values-change listener calls preventDefault()

heading.description: The heading over the list, and the group's name

category.description: Small tag next to the title, e.g. "Sales"

tone.description: Color of the tag – by default each category gets its own color in the order they appear

body.description: The prompt with variables in curly braces, e.g. "Summarize this for {audience}"

description.description: What to put in – shown on the tray while the field is focused or hovered
